response.sql: WITH first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS mean_unfilled FROM orderexecutions), order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS mean_unfilled FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), above_first AS (SELECT o.ordersmark, o.mean_unfilled, o.mean_unfilled - b.mean_unfilled AS excess_first FROM order_averages AS o CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b WHERE o.mean_unfilled > b.mean_unfilled), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(mean_unfilled) AS mean_unfilled FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(a.mean_unfilled) AS average_unfilled, AVG(a.excess_first) AS average_excess_first, AVG(a.mean_unfilled - b.mean_unfilled) AS average_excess_second FROM above_first AS a CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS b WHERE a.mean_unfilled > b.mean_unfilled;
